basics.name: Oscar A. Rodriguez
basics.label: Telecommunications Engineer
basics.summary:
I’m a Telecommunications Engineer currently working as a Cloud Automation Engineer with a strong focus on DevOps practices. I began my career managing virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V), transitioned into cloud administration with Azure and AWS, and eventually specialized in automation — where I discovered my true passion: coding and optimizing infrastructure.
I have hands-on experience with Go, Python, PowerShell, and Terraform, and I use these tools to automate cloud deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure management. I'm passionate about building reliable, scalable systems and continuously improving developer workflows.
I enjoy working in collaborative environments and learning from other engineers. Currently, I'm also expanding my skills in web development and data science to bring a broader perspective to problem-solving in DevOps.

work.name: Cloudnonic
work.summary:
Development and maintenance of backend services and RESTful APIs using Python and NestJS, following clean architecture and SOLID principles.
Design and implementation of cloud infrastructure on AWS, including EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
Building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps for automated testing and deployments.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) management with Terraform for scalable and reproducible cloud environments.
Collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver features, troubleshoot production issues, and improve system reliability.
